motivation: Community-buffering v1 showed that most exact-point Thalassia-loss events remained occupied by another seagrass, but did not distinguish persistence of pre-existing mixed patches from novel post-loss occupancy.

source.prerequisite: analysis/33_community_buffering.py output from pinned tbep-tech/obis-example commit 6c567beff95ea04f0e397101befb49d5233ace8f
source.stable_point_id: pinned child-event locationID = Transect + meter-mark Site
source.annual_state_rule: same consensus point-year rule as community-buffering v1; conflicting repeated visits within a point-year are excluded upstream

primary_population: All post-2016 exact stable-point transitions across Tampa Bay where source-year Thalassia is present and target-year Thalassia is absent.

H1_microsite_insurance.statement: Pre-existing mixed-species points are more likely than Thalassia-only points to remain occupied by another seagrass after exact-point Thalassia loss.

source_classes.mixed_source: source-year Thalassia present AND >=1 non-Thalassia seagrass taxon co-occurs at the same consensus point-year
source_classes.pure_thalassia_source: source-year Thalassia present AND no other seagrass taxon occurs at that consensus point-year

H1_microsite_insurance.endpoint: target-year point remains occupied by >=1 non-Thalassia seagrass after Thalassia loss
H1_microsite_insurance.estimator: difference in replacement fraction: mixed_source minus pure_thalassia_source
H1_microsite_insurance.uncertainty: stable-transect node-cluster bootstrap, resampling nodes with replacement; all eligible point-loss transitions from sampled nodes travel together
H1_microsite_insurance.support_rule: 95% bootstrap interval for mixed-minus-pure replacement fraction entirely above zero

H2_persistence_component.statement: Among replacement events, target alternative-seagrass occupancy more often contains at least one taxon already co-occurring at the source point than only newly appearing taxa.
H2_persistence_component.population: H1 events with target-year non-Thalassia seagrass occupancy
H2_persistence_component.persistent_component: source and target non-Thalassia taxon sets have non-empty intersection
H2_persistence_component.novel_only_component: target non-Thalassia taxon set is non-empty and has empty intersection with source non-Thalassia taxa
H2_persistence_component.estimator: fraction of replacement events with persistent component
H2_persistence_component.support_rule: 95% bootstrap interval for persistent-component fraction entirely above 0.5

claim_boundary: Post-hoc ecological hypothesis generated after opening the community-buffering result; not independent confirmation.
Microsite insurance means statistical persistence of seagrass occupancy after focal loss, not equivalent ecosystem function among species.
Annual observations cannot distinguish continuous survival of a co-occurring taxon from disappearance and reappearance between surveys.
A source mixed patch can reflect habitat filtering or shared environmental tolerance; this test does not establish facilitation or competition.
Do not change the all-bay primary population, source-class definitions, exact-point loss definition, bootstrap unit, event/node minima, or support rules after opening the derived endpoint.
